features.description: Idempotent task API, status, cancellation, SQLite/PostgreSQL stores and transactional outbox
SQS adapter, retry bounds, visibility heartbeat, DLQ and fake broker worker behavior
PostgreSQL lease and SQS visibility are renewed during a worker step longer than 30 seconds
SNS event parsing, event ID deduplication contract and handler retry behavior
Subprocess crash recovery with SQLite lease and effect ledger; service crash after committed effect
PostgreSQL idempotency and LocalStack SQS publish/consume/visibility/ack against Docker services
Service-backed retry exhaustion routes one message to the configured SQS dead-letter queue
Compose runtime, image build, and Terraform init/validate/plan against local LocalStack
Versioned runtime wheel with source provenance and isolated install smoke
Real model quality and cost metrics
features.evidence: No live model run is authorized or required
